/**
 * Data models for the Prose API (spec version 1.0.0).
 */
import type { BinaryInput, JsonObject, JsonValue } from '../core/json.js';

export type { BinaryInput, JsonObject, JsonValue };

/**
 * An API key. Documented at https://docs.test/keys.
 */
export interface Key {
  /**
   * uarp_<prefix>_<secret>; store and use as Authorization: Bearer <api_key>
   */
  value: string;
  /**
   * Free text. May contain [brackets], <angles> and a link like https://docs.test/notes.
   */
  note?: string;
}

export interface ListKeysResponse {
  items: Key[];
}
